name: Error-Driven Point Resampling & Grid Aggregation
definition: Accumulates per-pixel rendering errors from multiple camera views into a 3D voxel grid to compute mean error density, which guides point resampling for tetrahedral grid refinement.
summary: Error-Driven Point Resampling & Grid Aggregation refines tetrahedral grids by resampling points based on accumulated per-pixel rendering errors rather than topological neighbor status.
